datasets.title: Dams Mozambique
datasets.description: Adjusted shape file with position and names of dams in Mozambique watersheds.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/dams-mozambique]
datasets.details: Based on Aquastat world dam file www.fao.org and SEDAC, adjusted with field assessement and aerial photographs.

lineage.description: Dam locations and attributes were collected through direct observational assessment by UNDAC following Cyclone IDAI in Mozambique. The dataset was compiled into a shapefile with standardized attributes including dam height, reservoir capacity, and operational functions (irrigation, water supply, flood control, hydroelectric generation) across major river basins and sub-basins.

sources.name: UNDAC Dam Assessment after IDAI
sources.description: Post-event dam assessment conducted by UNDAC following Cyclone IDAI, providing observational data on dam locations, characteristics, and operational status in Mozambique watersheds
